description: What a secondhand item sells for on eBay: a calibrated estimate with a range, the recent real eBay sales behind it (sold comps, linked where the source gives a link), three list prices (fast, market, patient) with the 14-day sell chance, what the seller keeps after eBay fees, and a worth-it verdict when you pass what the user would pay. A description price searches the signed-in user's own eBay marketplace (eBay UK in GBP for a UK seller), eBay US in USD when nobody is signed in, or the site given in marketplace; price.currency names the currency. A photo price (image_url, a public https link) needs the user signed in through the connector: it runs a real scan on their account, priced in their own eBay marketplace and currency (price.currency). Without sign-in, describe the item; a description works but reads less than a photo.

brand.description: The brand or maker exactly as printed on the item, its tag or its label (for example "Simrad", "Pyrex", "Levi's"). Fill it from what you read on the item or the user's photo; leave it empty rather than guess.

condition.description: Condition as the user states it or as you see it on the item. Open box counts as Like New. "For parts or not working" is for an item that does not work, is broken, or is sold for repair or parts; it is priced against parts sales. When the description says for parts or not working, that wins over this field. Leave empty when unknown.

cost.description: What the user paid or would pay for it, for a worth-it verdict, in the currency the price comes back in (price.currency): the seller's own currency when signed in, USD otherwise, or the currency of the marketplace you pass.

description.description: What the item is: brand, model or pattern, size, any marks, completeness.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a photo of the item. Preferred over description alone.

marketplace.description: The eBay site to search: EBAY_US (eBay US, prices in USD) or EBAY_GB (eBay UK, prices in GBP). Leave it empty to use the signed-in user's own marketplace, or eBay US when nobody is signed in. Set it only when the user asks about a market other than their own. A photo scan always uses the account's own marketplace.

model.description: The model or product-line name as printed on the item or its box (for example "iPhone 12", "QuietComfort 35", "Odyssey G5", "501"). It is passed to the identification as a hint and added to the search when no word of it is already there; it never replaces the search. Put a manufacturer part number in part_number. Leave it empty rather than guess.

part_number.description: The manufacturer part number printed on the label or rating plate (for example "000-16294-001", "DCD771C2", "CUH-ZCT2U"), copied character for character. Not a size, voltage, year, SKU, ASIN, LPN or barcode. In price_item it is a hint to the identification only and is not added to the search (a part number required in every listing title leaves too few sales); in get_sold_comps it is appended to the query when the query lacks it. Leave it empty rather than guess.

size.description: Size as printed on the tag or measured (for example "M", "10.5", "36 x 36 in", "2.5 quart"). Fill it from the item or label when you can read it.

name: price_item
title: Price an item
